TIL the world’s richest monarch is King Maha Vajiralongkorn (Rama X) of Thailand, whose fortune is estimated at $30 billion or more. Despite ruling Thailand, he has spent much of his time living in Bavaria, Germany, where he owns lakeside property.
TIL captive orcas frequently have worn-down, broken, or intentionally drilled teeth because they chew and grind on concrete pool walls and steel gates out of stress and boredom

TIL of Mary Hardy Reeser, the 1951 "Cinder Woman" whose body burned almost entirely to ash while leaving the surrounding room virtually untouched. Though popular culture blamed spontaneous human combustion, the FBI attributed her death to the "wick effect".

TIL that from 1980 to 2014, the Wright Amendment banned commercial flights at Dallas Love Field from flying beyond Texas and its neighboring states. The law was passed to protect DFW Airport and mainly targeted Southwest Airlines.

TIL lions, tigers, leopards and jaguars are the only true roaring big cats. Cheetahs, pumas and even snow leopards can't roar, despite their impressive size and fearsome looks. Instead of roaring, they make sounds like hissing and purring.

TIL that genetically modified apples that don't brown upon exposure to air post-slicing exist, called "Arctic Apples". Scientists used gene silencing to turn off the enzyme that reacts with oxygen, keeping slices fresh-looking for days without preservatives.
TIL that Pixar came up with the idea of putting production babies in movie credits when they were making Toy Story. Since then, it has also become commonplace in video game credits.

TIL that Xavier Von Erck, founder of the group "Perverted Justice" behind the show "To Catch a Predator", once catfished a former member for months, even having online sex with him, to get him to leave his wife and publicly humiliate him by promising to meet up and live together
TIL Grand Tour cyclists (such the Tour de France) burn 5,000-8,000 calories on a mountain stage and up to 10,000 calories in daily expenditure.

TIL The Humbolt Squid reaches lengths of up to six feet and can weigh nearly one hundred pounds. They have incredible eyesight, a razor-sharp beak, eight tentacles with hooks on their suckers and they can hunt in groups of up to 1500.
